name: Fan
source:
Fan is the young next head of the Salamander Tribe. 
He is always calm, cool, and collected. He may look scary, but he’s actually pretty good at looking after others. He has extreme hatred towards anyone who enters his territory and occasionally shows bursts of anger and other violent emotions. 
Due to have a relationship of fire and water with Sera, they are on bad terms and often fight, but they also appreciate each other.

“I’ve decided. I’ll keep this woman alive for a while. Anyone with complaints can come say them to me.”
